1. (Currently amended) A system (100) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- an image interface (120) for obtaining the medical image (042);
- a user interface subsystem (140) for enabling a user to apply one or more graphical elements (310) to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, wherein the graphical elements are configured to identify anatomical structures or pathological findings not previously documented in the medical database; and
- a reporting subsystem (180) for:
i) accessing a medical database (060) comprising medical information items (062-066) which each represent medical reference information (400-414),
ii) retrieving a medical information item (062) from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item, wherein the association data is generated by a rule engine that applies domain-specific medical logic to correlate graphical element application patterns to specific medical information items, and
iii) generating a report (182) based on the medical information item, wherein the report includes structured medical data derived from the retrieved medical information item and integrated with the application data to produce a clinically actionable output.

2. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the medical information item (062) is associated with a codified version of the medical reference information (420), and wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information in generating the report (182), wherein the codified version is generated through a domain-specific encoding process that transforms unstructured medical reference information into standardized medical terminology codes.

3. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein:
- the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for displaying the medical reference information as a selectable graphical element (400-414) to the user, and
- the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information (420) in generating the report (182) based on the user selecting the selectable graphical element, wherein the selection triggers automated retrieval and integration of clinically relevant medical information specific to the anatomical location or pathological finding indicated by the user's graphical element application.

4. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using a macro (080) to generate the codified version of the medical reference information (420) from the medical reference information (400-414), wherein the macro encodes domain-specific medical knowledge and applies medical-specific transformation rules to convert reference information into standardized medical codes.

5. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 4, wherein the medical information item (062) comprises the macro (080) or a reference to the macro.

6. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the medical information items (062-066) are cross-referenced via hyperlinks, and wherein the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for enabling the user to interactively browse to another medical information item by selecting a hyperlink in the selectable graphical element (410-414), wherein the hyperlinks are generated based on medical domain relationships between anatomical structures or pathological findings.

7. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the selectable graphical element is a selectable overlay (410, 412), and wherein the user interface subsystem is arranged for displaying the medical reference information in the form of text (410, 412) or graphics (414) in the selectable overlay, wherein the overlay is dynamically generated based on the anatomical location or pathological finding identified by the user's graphical element application.

8. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) provide a measurement tool for enabling the user to perform a measurement on the medical image (042) using the user interface subsystem, and wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by measurement data (312) representing the measurement, wherein the measurement tool applies medical-specific measurement protocols and the measurement data is automatically correlated to medical reference information through domain-specific association rules.

9. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 8, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the measurement data (312) in generating the report (182).

10. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by a plurality of rules each linking a respective one of the one or more graphical elements (310) to a respective one of the medical information items (062-066), wherein the rules are generated through medical domain analysis and encode relationships between graphical element types and anatomical or pathological medical information.

11. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the application data represents one or more of the group of:
- a type of the one or more graphical elements (310);
- a position of the one or more graphical elements in the medical image; and
- an image structure (044) marked by the one or more graphical elements.

12. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) comprise one or more of the group of: a marker, an annotation and a measurement tool (310).

13. (Previously presented) Workstation or imaging apparatus comprising the system according to claim 1.

14. (Currently amended) A method (200) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- obtaining (210) the medical image;
- enabling (220) a user to apply one or more graphical elements to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, wherein the graphical elements are configured to identify anatomical structures or pathological findings not previously documented in the medical database;
- accessing (230) a medical database comprising medical information items which each represent medical reference information;
- retrieving (240) a medical information item from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item, wherein the association data is generated by applying domain-specific medical logic through a rule engine that correlates graphical element application patterns to specific medical information items; and
- generating (250) a report based on the medical information item, wherein the report includes structured medical data derived from the retrieved medical information item and integrated with the application data to produce a clinically actionable output.

15. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer program product (270) comprising instructions for causing a processor system to perform the method according to claim 14.
